Messages.Author: Screaming Vermillian
Messages.Body:
This came up in a tournament last night (Channel 10, Columbus Ohio).

Sire's Index Finger weilder is acting, nonacting minion throws some
agg, plays Rotschreck hoping to end combat, not sending acting minion
to torpor.

Can nonacting methuselah play Rot? What happens if he does?

What does IMMUNE mean?

We ruled IMMUNE meant something similar to dodge, and with recent
rulings of IMMUNE, anything that would happen to the character with
immunity wouldn't happen. Everything else, WOULD happen (hence the
ending combat).

Hope that made sense... Thanks.

card on him.

Messages.Author: J
Messages.Body:


Well, the answer is no and no.
The block attempt must be legal for you to use 2nd Tradition. As it
isn't, you then can't play Eagle's Sight. You would first need to play
somekind of wake, or untap ability (that doesn't demand blocking)
first, then play the Eagle's Sight, then play the 2nd Trad.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 20 Dec 2004 23:32:00 -0300, Enrique San Martín
<itan...@chile.com> wrote:

>This is the question:
>
>Can a tapped prince (or justicar) play Second Tradition to untap and
>attemp to block a (D) action who it's not to the controler of the
>prince??

No.

This is explicitly answered in the FAQ, section 3.31.

http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

>Ex.: Grand prey attemp to bleed 4 or 5 to his prey (the predator of the
>mathu), the predator attemp to block and fail, can Ulugh Begh play ST:D
>to untap and attemp block and then play eagly sight??? he get's the +2
>to the intercept???

Nope.

>I say yes, and yes... but my playgroup it's not much convinced...

You'd be wrong, and they would be right to not be convinced.

3.31 Can I use a card that requires me to block, to untap against an
action that is directed at someone else?

No.

Cards which require a block attempt as part of their untap effect (2nd
Tradition, Eternal Vigilance, Speak with Spirits, Special Report, The
Mole) cannot be played if your vampires cannot block the action. If
you want to block an action that is directed at someone else, you must
first play an Eagle's Sight or Falcon's Eye before playing a card that
untaps you and requires you to block. In other words, you would first
have to play a Wake with Evening's Freshness or Forced Awakening, then
play the Eagle's Sight or Falcon's Eye to gain the ability to block,
then you could use the untap and block cards.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Minions don't play Master cards.

Frenzy cannot be played on the Fingered vampire, by the above ruling.

Frenzy provides the round with a press. That press doesn't belong
to either of the combatants.
